item.title: Braedan Smart ties 3-point record
item.description: BROOKVILLE — Playing his final game Saturday at the Devils Den, senior Braedan Smart gave those in attendance a lifelong memory as he scored a career-high 36 points including making a school record tying eight 3-point baskets in leading Brookville to a 72-44 romp over the Madison Mohawks. The post Braedan Smart ties 3-point record appeared first on The Register Herald.

item.title: Preble first half mobile home taxes now payable
item.description: EATON — Preble County Treasurer Shannon Chappel announced that payment for the first half of 2026 mobile home taxes can now be made. When submitting tax payments, taxpayers are required to return the treasurer’s stub with their check. Questions regarding tax bills may be directed to the Preble County Treasurer’s Office.
